spec.title: Ink Moon Archipelago
spec.tagline: Glide through painted stone arches above a mist-washed ink sea toward the crescent moon.

world.basePrompt: A vast monochrome ink-wash seascape stretches ahead: colossal weathered stone arches rise from calm grey water, their crowns tufted with pine trees. Sheer cliffs with thin waterfalls flank the route, floating rock islands drift in the mist, and layered mountain silhouettes fade into a pale wash sky. Far ahead a slender crescent moon hangs over the horizon, framed by the arches. Soft fog rolls across the water, brushstroke clouds streak the sky, and the scene continues in deepening washes of grey toward the moonlit distance.

landmarks.description: The largest mossy stone arch rising from the water, crowned with pine trees
Two smaller stone arches standing side by side in the middle distance
A slender crescent moon hovering low over the misty horizon
Sheer ink-dark cliffs with thin waterfalls on both sides of the channel

entities.label: Misty channel between the waterfall cliffs

spec.cartridgeLine: One brush, one sea of mist, three arches between you and the crescent moon. Fly the ink.
